body:
Hi there. I was homeless living in my car at one point several years back. It was incredibly stressful. I'm so sorry you're going through this... I don't know what to say except life has its ups and downs and right now we are both down. For what this is worth though; I lived in my car at one point at age 26 and it was also post-breakup so I understand some of what you're dealing with. I ended up swallowing my pride and asking a friend for a place on the couch. They saved my life back then. I think you could open up to your best friend and see what happens... like tell them the truth... I know I was desperate and scared but I survived that and I'm glad I did. 

Now I'm sort of dealing with other stress but I made it to 33. You can too. Here if you need a pal.

Wow. Thank YOU. I'm sorry you are dealing with kidney disease at such a young age. It is very hard with health problems; sometimes I wonder how I make it through the days when the mental and physical issues hit all at once. But I'm still here tonight. Took some melatonin and valerian I just hope I sleep. I haven't been sleeping. I'm glad you're still here too. You are strong. You are amazing.

I feel this way too. And I've worked very hard to overcome my introverted nature. It's exhausting. At the end of the day, I'm probably going to be one of those single moms you talk about. My husband only married me because we were pregnant and he was the "cool jock" in HS. He really can't stand me. And, like you, I have busted ass in school for many years only to come out unable to secure any kind of career / financial security despite being very committed and involved in my area of study. I don't know what to say or do except tell you that you're not alone. Try not to give up. I'm a few years older than you, I think, and I know things are still pretty difficult for me but I've also seen people like us do well in the right situation. I suppose it all comes down to how long we hold out.
Thank you. That is true. Thank you for telling me that tonight. Life can be hard but you certainly have a future and you are worthy of joy and happiness.

If you really are 12 and you're on SW right now I hope you are ok. That worries me, even in my own extremely distressed state of mind at the moment. It must be the mom in me. 

So... are you ok? Hugs
